description: SPICE kernels used by helioswarm M2+: leap seconds, IAU rotation/shape constants, DE440 GM values and the DE440 short planetary ephemeris (1849-12-26 to 2150-01-22). Load order is the list order; later kernels take priority for any kernel-pool variable defined twice.
license: NAIF generic kernels are produced by NASA/JPL NAIF and distributed publicly without restriction (https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/naif/rules.html). They are not committed to this repository; scripts/fetch_kernels.py downloads them.
hash_policy: NAIF does not publish SHA-256 checksums for these files. Each SHA-256 below was computed by helioswarm on first retrieval (trust on first use) and is enforced from then on: fetch_kernels refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Where NAIF publishes an MD5 (spk/planets/aa_checksums.txt) it is recorded and was cross-checked at retrieval; it is also enforced.

kernels.name: naif0012.tls
kernels.purpose: Leap-seconds kernel: UTC <-> TDB conversion (str2et, et2utc). Contains leap seconds up to 2017-01-01 (TAI-UTC = 37 s).

kernels.name: pck00011.tpc
kernels.purpose: Text PCK: IAU WGCCRE rotation models and radii (IAU_EARTH frame, used from M3).

kernels.name: gm_de440.tpc
kernels.purpose: Text PCK of DE440 gravitational parameters GM (km^3 s^-2), read with bodvrd.

kernels.name: de440s.bsp
kernels.purpose: DE440 short planetary ephemeris (SPK): Sun, planetary-system barycentres, Mercury, Venus, Earth and Moon relative to the solar-system barycentre, 1849-2150.
